column1: # The Qur'an retells or answers these Bible passages. A line pairs a Bible
# range with the Qur'an passages that treat the same figure, event or
# teaching; the note names the parallel in a few words. Where the pairing
# rests on Muslim exegesis rather than on the text, the note says so.
# References use the app's OSIS book codes and standard Qur'an numbering.
# -- Creation, Adam and Eve, Cain and Abel -----------------------------------

column3: Creation of the heavens and the earth in six days

Creation by the word: Be, and it is
The vicegerent on earth; Adam taught the names
Man formed from clay, given of God's spirit; the angels commanded to bow, Iblis refuses
Adam and his wife in the Garden; the forbidden tree
Humankind created from a single soul and its mate
The tempter, the tree, the leaves of the Garden
Adam's repentance and the descent to earth
From the earth created, to it returned, from it brought forth again
Cain and Abel: the two sacrifices, the murder, the raven
Whoever kills one soul, it is as if he killed all mankind
Enoch (Idris), raised to a high station
Noah's preaching, the mockers, the building of the ark

Noah among his people a thousand years less fifty

I, even I, am God; there is no god but Me

Manna and quails; the shading cloud
Water from the rock: twelve springs for twelve tribes
Jethro, whom tradition identifies with the prophet Shu'ayb, preaching to Midian
The covenant at the mountain raised above them
Commandments: no other god, honour parents, no killing, no adultery, no theft, just measure
The people ask for a god like the idols they see
The Sabbath, and the town that broke it
Life for life, eye for eye; and forgiveness as atonement

Moses seizes Aaron by the head and beard

Foods forbidden to the Children of Israel
Kindness to parents, kin, orphans, the needy, the neighbour, the wayfarer

The Sabbath-breakers
Korah, his treasures, and the earth that swallowed him
The cow to be sacrificed; the questions about it; the dead restored
The man given God's revelations who threw them off (whom tradition identifies with Balaam)
Say: He is God, the One
The prophet to come, as Muslim exegesis reads these verses
Nearer to him than his jugular vein
The river test, told of Saul's army

The people ask for a king; Saul appointed
David slays Goliath
The two litigants and the ewes; David's repentance
David's penitence and God's forgiveness
The children of Adam honoured; man created in the best stature

Elisha among the prophets

Born of a virgin; Jesus likened to Adam
John, confirming a Word from God

Jesus confirming the Torah
Divorce and its limits

Alms given secretly, and alms spoiled by reproach
The Opening: the prayer of the Muslim
Fasting prescribed, as it was prescribed for those before
Hoarded gold and silver
How many a creature carries not its own provision
Ask, and I answer the suppliant

Not a leaf falls but He knows it

Divorce
The camel through the needle's eye

The prophets slain
The sanctuary entered and laid waste

The table sent down from heaven at the disciples' request

The man with two gardens

Bread from heaven for the disciples

Those nearest to Abraham are those who follow him
Abraham's trial; Abraham God's friend
A day as a thousand years
He is the Forgiving, the Loving
The First and the Last, the Outward and the Inward
Gog and Magog
The book of deeds opened
